Keep this same SMALL narrow Rheinland pirate cargo craft, same cabin, main body, roof cap, neck, two small rear engines, paint, drawing style, page layout and title. All three views must remain.

Integrate a row of THREE short stout retractable cylindrical/faceted drum units into each shoulder: one larger central drum and two smaller flanking drums, matching the source mechanism in IMAGE 2. These are solid equipment/armour bosses on recessed sliding collars, NOT guns, rocket pods, thrusters or wheels. Show modest cylindrical depth and thick guide sleeves; no long rods, barrels or glowing holes.

Perspective must show the mass and thickness of the armoured cheek, and the larger middle drum clearly. Make the cargo hatch below/behind the mechanism accessible.
Any small empty equipment mounting socket formerly on a wing may be integrated flush into the top of the thick hull shoulder. Do not add weapons. Remove obsolete former wing sockets rather than layering new cylinders onto surviving wings.

Exactly the original three views, all FLIGHT: big perspective, side profile, top view. No fourth folded diagram or extra craft. Change ONLY the lateral-wing design into integrated bulky hull projections with the source-style retractable cylinders.
